caseName: Local 254 v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Local 254, Building Service Employees International Union, AFL-CIO v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: Arthur V. Getchell for petitioner., Solicitor General Marshall, Arnold Ordman, Dominick L. Manoli and Norton J. Come for respondent.

opinions.text:
C. A. 1st Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
